# SkillBun Full System Documentation & Free Career Roadmap Catalog

> SkillBun (https://skillbun.tech) is a **100% Free** AI-powered career discovery, learning roadmap, and certification platform for tech students pursuing BCA, BSc, B.Tech, and MCA degrees.

## 🎁 100% Free Policy
- **100% Free Access**: Every roadmap, study guide, AI quiz, AI counsellor chat, and digital certificate is completely free.
- **No Paywalls or Hidden Charges**: No credit card registration required.
- **Free Verifiable Certificates**: Students can earn, download, and share official verified digital certificates at zero cost.

## 🗺️ Complete 100+ Free Career Roadmaps Catalog

### 1. Artificial Intelligence & Data Science (100% Free)
- **AI/ML Engineer**: Math foundations, Python, PyTorch/TensorFlow, LLMs, LangChain, Model Deployment.
- **AI Research Engineer**: Deep learning research, Transformers, Reinforcement Learning, Math & Proofs.
- **Data Scientist**: Statistics, EDA, Scikit-Learn, Deep Learning, MLOps.
- **Generative AI Developer**: RAG architectures, Vector Databases, Prompt Engineering, Fine-tuning.
- **Data Engineer**: SQL, Data Pipelines, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, Airflow.
- **MLOps Engineer**: Model CI/CD, MLflow, Kubeflow, Model Monitoring.

### 2. Software Development & Web Engineering (100% Free)
- **Full Stack Developer**: HTML/CSS/JS, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL/MongoDB, Cloud hosting.
- **Frontend Developer**: Modern JavaScript, React/Vue/Svelte, CSS Systems, Web Performance, State Management.
- **Backend Developer**: Go/Java/Node/Python, REST/GraphQL APIs, Microservices, Caching, System Design.
- **Next.js Developer**: App Router, SSR, SSG, Server Actions, API Routes, Turbopack.
- **Python Developer**: Core Python, Django/FastAPI, AsyncIO, Testing, Automation.

### 3. Mobile & Systems Engineering (100% Free)
- **Android Developer**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Architecture Components.
- **iOS Developer**: Swift, SwiftUI, Combine, iOS SDK.
- **Flutter Developer**: Dart, Cross-platform UI, Provider/Riverpod, Native plugins.
- **React Native Developer**: JavaScript/TypeScript, Native bridges, Redux, Expo.

### 4. Cloud, DevOps & Cybersecurity (100% Free)
- **DevOps & Cloud Engineer**: Linux, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, AWS/Azure/GCP.
- **Cybersecurity Specialist**: Networking, Ethical Hacking, SOC Operations, DFIR, Pen Testing.
- **Penetration Tester**: Network exploitation, Web security, Metasploit, Burp Suite.

## 📚 How a Student Progresses
1. **Onboarding** — create a free account, record degree and current year.
2. **Career discovery quiz** — an adaptive quiz about interests, work preferences, and practical scenarios that recommends career paths. It does not certify technical proficiency, and its results stay in the current quiz session.
3. **Roadmap** — work through topic nodes with available study guides, video tutorials, and documentation links. Resources vary by topic, and full guides require sign-in.
4. **Progress tracking** — completed topic nodes accumulate against the track.
5. **Certification** — the timed exam unlocks at 60% roadmap completion and includes focus and copy controls.
6. **Credential** — a score of at least 70% qualifies for a publicly verifiable certificate.

Bun-Bot is a dedicated AI career chat that uses the student's profile and current conversation. The projects hub offers practice ideas and step-by-step blueprints; it does not host or grade student submissions.

## 🎓 Free Certification System & Anti-Cheating Controls
- Users complete 60%+ of any roadmap to unlock certification.
- 10 questions randomly selected from a fixed 50-question bank (3 Easy, 5 Moderate, 2 Hard), with shuffled question and option order.
- 45-second timer per question, 70% passing grade.
- Focus-loss detection, text-selection blocking, and watermark identification during the exam.
- Grading is performed on the server. Correct answers are withheld during the active attempt; the graded review can include correct answers and explanations.
- Retakes are free. Up to 3 attempts are allowed per 24 hours per roadmap, and a 1-hour study cooldown applies after two consecutive failures.
- Free public verification at `https://skillbun.tech/certificate/[id]`, with an ID lookup at `https://skillbun.tech/certificate`. Verification shows credential details and revocation status while the record exists. Deleting a student account deletes its roadmap certificates; workforce and legal records are retained separately.

## ✉️ Email Communication Policy

SkillBun sends account email, admin-reviewed learning reminders, and workforce correspondence. The student platform has no billing or card-payment flow.

**Supported categories:**
- **Account access** — signup verification codes and requested password-reset links.
- **Learning reminders** — onboarding guidance, progress reminders, exam eligibility, retake guidance, and certificate information. Admins review and dispatch these messages; they are not automatically sent at every milestone.
- **Workforce** — formal correspondence such as offer, extension, termination, and relieving letters.

**Addresses — this list is exhaustive:**
- `noreply@skillbun.tech` — the automated platform sender. It is outgoing-only and never receives replies.
- `harsh@skillbun.tech` — the only address that receives mail. All correspondence, replies, and signed documents go here.

SkillBun does **not** operate `support@`, `careers@`, `hiring@`, `hello@`, `admin@` or `contact@` addresses on any domain, and does not use the domain `skillbun.com`. Mail claiming to be from SkillBun at any of those addresses did not come from SkillBun.

**Mail handling:**
- SkillBun never requests a password, one-time code, card number, or payment by email.
- Learning reminder emails include an unsubscribe link; transactional account and workforce messages are separate from those preferences.
- Email templates include light and dark theme support with fallback styles. Rendering varies by email client, and hosted logos may be hidden when images are blocked.
